authority: G1 owner relays parent operational task direction and subsequent adaptive-mode confirmation; not a human Decision Log ruling or permission/configuration change.
direction: Degraded mode admits ONE fit/proof at a time when pressure NORMAL or WARNING (never CRITICAL), free+max(inactive,purgeable)>=remaining observed-peak reservation with NO1GiBfloor, disk free>=20GiB. Record expected swapping, wall time and pressure history. Wrapped proof first, then fits.
adaptiveConfirmation: Each admission evaluates normal gate first: five consecutive NORMAL readings spaced at least30s AND normal floor clear. Otherwise use degraded. Reversible both directions; degraded cap1 prevents another admission alongside existing fits. Running work is never killed.
reservations: Observed high-water minus each live fit RSS; retain every valid observation, including refusals.
commitHold: Do not commit until G1 owner releases assembly frontier; actual admission follows reviewed committed preparation.
